Courses / Patterns in Software Engineering (IN2081)Login Overview Title Patterns in Software Engineering (IN2081) Number 0000003584 Persons involvedHeadKrusche, StephanLecturer (Assistant)Krusche, StephanBernius, Jan PhilipType lecture with integrated exercises (VI) Semester weekly hours 4 ECTS credits-Course language/s English Offered in Winter semester 2020/21 Organisation Informatics 1 - Chair of Distributed Systems and Operating Systems (Prof. Bhatotia)  Description Content- Patterns as approach to structure and describe expert knowledge 
- Pattern-based software development 
- Categories of Patterns: 
  - Architectural Patterns 
  - design Patterns 
  - Analysis Patterns 
  - Process Patterns 
  - project management Patterns 
  - Classification and Combination of Patterns 
- Using Patterns: 
  - in Analysis 
  - in design 
  - in existing models and legacy systemsPrevious knowledge expectedPrerequisite: Introduction to Software Engineering (Module IN0006)ObjectiveYou will learn the principles of patterns in software development and the structure of pattern-based software systems. You will also become familiar how to apply patterns in a variety of problem situations and how handle the patterns in concrete applications. You will practice application of the patterns in exercises during the lecture.

Note the special course format: Lectures and Exercise are not separate, they are heavily intertwined. The course blends exercises with the lecture: the exercises are being held in the class room right after the pattern is introduced.Teaching and learning methodModul IN0006Course Criteria and Registration-Further informationOnline informationcourse documentse-learning course (moodle)Additional informationadditional informationcurrent informationconsulting hour / contactvirtual lecture hall (zoom, stream, ...)
